policy: Every shipped native/data artifact is bound to an exact source entry, build script hash, dependency-cache manifest, output byte length/hash, APK path and local license/NOTICE file in manifest.json.

correspondingSource.method: Run scripts/research/fetch-native-engine-inputs.sh, which downloads and verifies all 13 canonical archives; scripts/research/create-builder-input-archive.sh then creates the audited allowlisted builder input archive. LGPL Rime source/data archives are included unmodified alongside Feelime's original schema and adapters.

inputArchive.verification: The builder reassembled the transferred chunks, matched byte length and SHA-256, verified every inputs.sha256 entry and required exact path/length equality with inputs.entries.

excludedReason: No excluded package contributed code, library, model or dictionary bytes to the APK.
modifications: No upstream source was modified. Feelime adapters and the independently authored natural-code double-pinyin Rime schema are separate original files; the schema was compiled with the pinned host librime deployer.
releaseObligation: A production release must ship this license bundle and make the exact corresponding-source archives plus Feelime adapter/schema source available.
